summary_en: NICHIAS approved acquisition of up to 1.3 million shares (0.69% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 3.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 to March 31, 2027, aimed at enhancing shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, NICHIAS Corporation's board of directors resolved to acquire treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 165(3). The company will acquire up to 1.3 million shares of common stock for a maximum total purchase price of 3.0 billion yen. The acquisition represents 0.69% of outstanding shares (calculated against 187,868,563 shares outstanding excluding treasury shares as of October 31, 2026).

The shares will be acquired through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 11, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The company stated that the purpose of the acquisition is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
